title: Guri raadin
description: Ten short stories about living and housing: a small rented hut in Hargeysa, a house move in the rain, cleaning and perfuming a new house in Jigjiga, a father-in-law on the top floor in Mogadishu, a house by the park in Nairobi, a greedy flatmate in London, the old stone houses of Seylac, a tenants' meeting in Minneapolis, a house between the sea and the desert in Boosaaso and a letter from a new home in Boorama.

lessons.title: Baraakada Saredo
lessons.summary: Nineteen-year-old Farhaan comes to Hargeysa to start university in September; Saredo rents him the small rectangular tin-roofed hut behind her house, they agree on the deposit, and he buys mats and a towel for his narrow new room.
lessons.text:
Farhaan waa wiil sagaal iyo toban jir ah. Wuxuu ka yimid tuulo yar oo u dhow Ceerigaabo. Bisha sebteembar wuxuu wax ka baran doonaa jaamacadda Hargeysa. Sebteembar waa dhow yahay, laakiin Farhaan guri ma haysto. Lacag badanna ma haysto.

Saaxiib ayaa u sheegay in naag la yidhaahdo Saredo ay haysato baraako madhan. Farhaan wuxuu tagay guriga Saredo. Baraakadu waxay ku taal gurigeeda gadaashiisa. Baraako waa guri yar oo geed laga sameeyay, korkiisuna waa bir.

"Baraakadu waa kis tahay," ayay tidhi Saredo. "Laakiin waa nadiif."

Farhaan wuu galay baraakada. Qolku waa laydi. Laydigu waa dheer yahay, laakiin qolku ma aha qol balaar ah. Farhaan gacmaha ayuu kala fidiyay. Gacmaha ayaa gaadhay labada dhinac ee qolka. Farhaan wuxuu rabay qol ballaran oo balaar ah. Laakiin qolkani waa kis yahay.

"Immisa ayaa bishii la bixiyaa?" ayuu weydiiyay Farhaan.

"Bishii waa 50 doolar," ayay tidhi Saredo. "Waxaa kale oo jira carbuun. Carbuunku waa 50 doolar. Haddii aad baraakada si fiican u haysato, carbuunka waan kuu celin doonaa markaad baxdo."

"Immisa oo dhan?" ayuu weydiiyay Farhaan. "100 doolar? Lacagtaas oo dhan ma hayo. Waxaan hayaa 70 doolar oo keliya."

"Haye," ayay tidhi Saredo. "Maanta i sii lacagta bisha sebteembar iyo 20 doolar oo carbuun ah. Inta kale ee carbuunka bisha oktoobar ayaad i siin doontaa."

Farhaan aad buu u faraxsanaa. Wuxuu Saredo siiyay 70 doolar. Saredo waxay siisay furaha baraakada.

Baraakadu sariir ma lahayn. Farhaan wuxuu tagay suuqa, wuxuuna iibsaday dermo. Dermaha ayuu dhulka dhigay. Dermahu waa laydi sida qolka oo kale. Kadib wuxuu iibsaday shukumaan cagaar ah. Shukumaanka wuxuu saaray albaabka.

Habeenkaas Farhaan wuxuu ku seexday dermaha. Qolka kis ah ayuu eegay. "Qolkani ma aha qol ballaran, mana aha qol balaar ah," ayuu yidhi. "Laakiin waa qolkayga."

Su'aalo:
Farhaan goorma ayuu wax ka baran doonaa jaamacadda?
Farhaan wuxuu wax ka baran doonaa jaamacadda bisha sebteembar.
Baraakada yaa leh?
Baraakada waxaa leh Saredo.
Qolku ma ballaran yahay?
Maya. Qolku waa kis yahay, waana laydi.
Carbuunku immisa buu ahaa?
Carbuunku wuxuu ahaa 50 doolar.
Farhaan muxuu suuqa ka iibsaday?
Farhaan wuxuu iibsaday dermo iyo shukumaan.

lessons.title: Guurka roobka dhexdiisa
lessons.summary: Khaliif, his wife Hodman and their son Najiib move from Burco to a bigger house near Oodweyne; a downpour and lightning catch them on the road, a wheel of their car sinks in the mud, Khaliif knots a rope to the car and the men pull it out, and they reach the new house tired and hungry.
lessons.text:
Khaliif iyo xaaskiisa Hodman waxay ku noolaayeen guri yar oo ku yaal Burco. Wiilkooda Najiib wuxuu ahaa toban jir. Gurigu wuxuu ahaa mid aad u yar. Waxay heleen guri ka weyn oo u dhow Oodweyne.

Maalintii guurka, Khaliif wuxuu kiraystay babuur. Babuurtu waxay ahayd baabuur yar oo afar shaag leh. Waxay babuurta saareen sariirta, kursiyada, dermaha iyo dharka.

Cirka daruuro madow ayaa ku jiray. "Mayay ayaa iman doona," ayay tidhi Hodman. "Mayaygu wuu xun yahay. Maanta ha guurin."

"Waxba ma dhici doonaan," ayuu yidhi Khaliif. "Waynu tagaynaa."

Waddada dhexdeeda, mayaygii wuu yimid. Roob aad u badan ayaa da'ay. Cirka biriq ayaa ka muuqatay. Biriqdu waxay ahayd mid aad u weyn. Kadib onkod ayaa yimid. Najiib cabsi buu qabay. "Aabbo, biriqda eeg!" ayuu yidhi.

Waddadu waxay noqotay dhooqo. Dhooqadu waxay ahayd mid madow oo culus. Shaagga hore ee babuurta ayaa dhooqada galay. Khaliif babuurta wuu kaxeeyay, laakiin shaaggu wuu wareegay oo keliya. Babuurtu meesheedii bay joogtay.

"Xarig ayaan haynaa," ayay tidhi Hodman. Khaliif wuxuu xariggii ku nuday babuurta horteeda. "Si fiican ugu nud," ayay tidhi Hodman. Khaliif mar labaad ayuu nuday.

Laba nin oo meel u dhow joogay ayaa yimid. Saddexdii nin waxay bilaabeen jiidid. Jiididdu way adkayd. Mayayga hoostiisa ayay xarigga jiideen. Hodman babuurta ayay kaxaysay. Jiidid dheer kadib, shaaggu dhooqada wuu ka soo baxay.

"Mahadsanid," ayuu ku yidhi Khaliif labada nin.

Galabtii waxay gaadheen guriga cusub. Mayaygu wuu joogsaday. Dhammaan way daallanaayeen, dharkooduna wuxuu ahaa dhooqo. "Waan daallanahay," ayuu yidhi Khaliif. "Aniguna waan gaajaysanahay," ayuu yidhi Najiib. "Anigu sidoo kale waan gaajaysanahay," ayay tidhi Hodman.

Hodman waxay samaysay bariis iyo hilib. Qoyska gaajaysan ayaa wada cunay bariiska iyo hilibka. Kadibna way seexdeen.

Su'aalo:
Khaliif muxuu kiraystay?
Khaliif wuxuu kiraystay babuur.
Maxaa cirka ka muuqday?
Cirka biriq ayaa ka muuqatay.
Shaagga hore maxaa ku dhacay?
Shaagga hore wuxuu galay dhooqada.
Khaliif xarigga muxuu ku sameeyay?
Khaliif xarigga wuxuu ku nuday babuurta.
Najiib muxuu yidhi markay guriga gaadheen?
Najiib wuxuu yidhi: "Waan gaajaysanahay."
Qoysku sidee buu ahaa markay guriga gaadheen?
Qoysku wuxuu ahaa daallan oo gaajaysan.

lessons.title: Uunsiga guriga cusub
lessons.summary: Cibaado and Mubaarak have moved into a new house in Jigjiga, and his mother is coming on Friday; Cibaado scrubs the floor with powder, wipes and rinses everything, smokes the water jar with qoodhi wood and burns incense, Mubaarak sneezes and blows ash over the clean floor, and the mother praises the sweet-smelling water and the tea with cream.
lessons.text:
Cibaado iyo ninkeeda Mubaarak waxay u guureen guri cusub oo ku yaal Jigjiga. Jimcaha, hooyada Mubaarak ayaa u iman doonta gurigooda cusub. Cibaado waxay rabtaa in gurigu nadiif noqdo.

Subaxdii Jimcaha, Cibaado waxay biyo ku dartay xash. Biyaha xash leh ayay dhulka ku dhaqday. Kadib tirtirid ayay bilowday. Waxay tirtirtay miiska, kursiyada iyo albaabka. Tirtiriddu waxay qaadatay saacad.

Kadib koobabka ayay biyo nadiif ah ku mayrtay. Waxay sidoo kale mayrtay mawada. Mawadu waa wax biyaha lagu shubo. Cibaado mawada saddex jeer ayay mayrtay.

Kadib Cibaado waxay keentay qoodhi. Qoodhidu waa geed, qiiqiisuna urin fiican buu leeyahay. Waxay qoodhida dab ku shiday, kadibna waxay dhigtay mawada dhexdeeda. Qiiqa qoodhida ayaa mawada buuxiyay. "Haddii biyaha mawada lagu shubo, urin fiican ayay yeelan doonaan," ayay tidhi Cibaado.

Galabtii Cibaado waxay shiday uunsi. Uunsigu wuxuu ahaa mid ay ka keentay suuqa. Urinta uunsiga ayaa guriga oo dhan buuxisay. Urintu waxay ahayd mid aad u fiican.

Mubaarak ayaa guriga soo galay. "Waa maxay urintan?" ayuu weydiiyay. Kadibna wuu hindhisay. Mar kale ayuu hindhisay. "Qiiqa uunsiga ayaa iga dhigaya inaan hindhiso," ayuu yidhi.

Mubaarak dabka uunsiga ayuu afuufay. Danbas ayaa dhulka ku daatay. Danbaska madow ayaa ku dhacay dhulkii nadiifta ahaa. "Mubaarak!" ayay tidhi Cibaado. Mar kale ayay tirtirid bilowday, danbaskiina way ka qaadday dhulka.

Habeenkii hooyada Mubaarak way timid. Waxay ka cabtay biyaha mawada. "Biyahan urin fiican bay leeyihiin," ayay tidhi. Cibaado waxay u keentay shaah iyo labeen. Labeentu waxay ahayd mid cad oo macaan. Hooyadu shaaha labeenta leh way jeclaatay. "Gurigiinnu waa nadiif yahay, urintiisuna waa fiican tahay," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Cibaado maxay biyaha ku dartay?
Cibaado waxay biyaha ku dartay xash.
Cibaado maxay dhigtay mawada dhexdeeda?
Cibaado waxay mawada dhexdeeda dhigtay qoodhi dab ku jiro.
Mubaarak muxuu sameeyay markuu urinta uunsiga dareemay?
Mubaarak wuu hindhisay.
Maxaa dhulka ku daatay?
Danbas ayaa dhulka ku daatay.
Cibaado maxay hooyada u keentay?
Cibaado waxay hooyada u keentay shaah iyo labeen.

lessons.title: Soddogga iyo guriga dheer
lessons.summary: Nuradiin and Istar live in Mogadishu at the top of a tall building; her old father Cabdiqani comes from Afgooye with his cane, and the climb hurts his elbow and neck, so the family looks for a house on the ground where the old man can come and go easily.
lessons.text:
Nuradiin iyo xaaskiisa Istar waxay ku nool yihiin Muqdisho. Muqdisho waa magaalomadaxda Soomaaliya. Magaalomadaxdu waa magaalo weyn oo dad badan leh. Nuradiin iyo Istar waxay ku nool yihiin qolal ku yaal guri dheer. Qolalkoodu waa kuwa ugu sarreya ee guriga.

Aabbaha Istar waa Cabdiqani. Cabdiqani waa soddogga Nuradiin. Soddoggu wuxuu ku noolaa tuulo u dhow Afgooye. Hadda soddoggu waa nin weyn, wuxuuna ku socdaa xood. Bishan, soddoggu wuxuu u yimid magaalomadaxda si uu ula joogo Istar iyo Nuradiin.

Soddoggu wuu eegay guriga dheer. "Ma qolalka ugu sarreya ayaad ku nool tihiin?" ayuu weydiiyay. "In halkaas la fuulo ma aha wax hawlyar ah."

Nuradiin wuxuu qaaday shandadda soddogga. "Kaley, aabbo," ayuu yidhi. "Waynu fuuli doonnaa, kadibna waynu istaagi doonnaa."

Soddoggu xoodkiisa ayuu ku tiirsaday. Wuu fuulay, wuuna istaagay, kadibna mar kale ayuu fuulay. "Abboowe, i sug," ayuu soddoggu ku yidhi Nuradiin. Nuradiin wuu sugay. "Kaley, kaley," ayuu yidhi.

Markay gaadheen qolalka ugu sarreya, soddoggu wuu daallanaa. Suxulka xanuun baa ku jiray, waayo xoodka ayuu aad ugu tiirsanaa. Luqunta sidoo kale xanuun baa ku jiray. "Suxulkayga iyo luquntayda ayaa xanuun leh," ayuu yidhi.

"Aabbo, jiifsan," ayay tidhi Istar. "Abboowe, waan jiifsanayaa," ayuu yidhi soddoggu. Soddoggu sariirta ayuu ku jiifsanayaa. Istar waxay suxulka iyo luqunta u marisay saliid kulul.

Habeenkii, Nuradiin iyo Istar way wada hadleen. "Aabbahay maalin walba ma fuuli karo halkan," ayay tidhi Istar. "Haddii aynu helno guri dhulka ku yaal, noloshiisu way hawlyar noqon lahayd."

Toddobaadkii dambe, Nuradiin wuxuu raadiyay guri. Wuxuu helay guri yar oo dhulka ku yaal oo beer yar leh. Soddoggu wuu eegay. "Abboowe, gurigan waa hawlyar," ayuu yidhi. "Xoodkayga iyo anigu waan ku faraxsannahay."

Su'aalo:
Waa maxay magaalomadaxda Soomaaliya?
Magaalomadaxda Soomaaliya waa Muqdisho.
Soddogga Nuradiin waa kuma?
Soddogga Nuradiin waa Cabdiqani, aabbaha Istar.
Soddoggu muxuu ku socdaa?
Soddoggu wuxuu ku socdaa xood.
Maxaa xanuun ku jiray?
Suxulka iyo luqunta soddogga ayaa xanuun ku jiray.
Nuradiin muxuu helay?
Nuradiin wuxuu helay guri yar oo dhulka ku yaal oo beer yar leh.

lessons.title: Gurigayga u dhow beerta xayawaanka
lessons.summary: Nuura tells how she and her husband Rashaad rented a house on the edge of Nairobi next to the national park: frogs sing in the pond at night, a turtle and a hare live in the garden, and over the fence they see giraffes, ostriches and a rhino with her calf.
lessons.text:
Magacaygu waa Nuura. Ninkayga Rashaad iyo aniga waxaynu ku nool nahay Nairobi. Sannadkan waxaynu u guurnay guri ku yaal Nairobi dhinaceeda, meel u dhow beerta xayawaanka. Waxaan idiin sheegayaa gurigayga iyo xayawaanka ku nool agagaarkiisa.

Gurigayagu wuxuu leeyahay beer yar. Beerta dhexdeeda waxaa ku yaal biyo yar. Biyaha waxaa ku nool rah badan. Habeenkii rahu hees buu qaadaa. Heesidda raha ayaan maqlaa habeen walba. Heesidda raha way dhibtaa Rashaad. "Ma seexan karo," ayuu yidhi. Aniga heesiddooda waan jeclahay.

Maqliddaydu waa fiican tahay. Maqlidda Rashaad way ka yar tahay maqliddayda. Habeenkii waxaan maqlaa wax walba. Mar, waxaan maqlay cod yar oo beerta ka yimid. Waxaan qaatay nal, waana eegay. Waxay ahayd qoolley. Qoolleyaha socodkiisu wuxuu ahaa mid aad u yar. Hadda beertayada waxaa ku nool qoolleyaha. Khudaar ayaan siinnaa.

Subaxdii waxaa beerta yimaada bakayle. Bakaylaha dhegahiisu waa dheer yihiin, saynkiisuna waa yar yahay. Saynta bakaylaha waa cad tahay. Markuu i arko, wuu ordaa. Saynta cad ayaan arkaa oo keliya.

Beertayada gadaasheeda waxaa ku yaal beerta xayawaanka. Halkaas waxaan ka arkaa geri. Gerida qoodha ayaa aad u dheer. Qoodha dheer ayay ku cunaysaa caleemaha geedaha sare. Gerida saynteedu waa dheer tahay, waxayna leedahay timo madow.

Mar mar waxaan arkaa gorayo. Gorayadu waa shimbir weyn, laakiin ma duusho. Gorayadu si dhaqso ah ayay u ordi kartaa. Orodkeedu wuxuu ka dhaqso badan yahay baabuur yar. Qoodha gorayada sidoo kale waa dheer yahay.

Maalin, Rashaad ayaa igu yidhi, "Nuura, kaalay!" Waxaan aragnay wiyil iyo ilmaheeda. Wiyishu waa xayawaan aad u weyn oo gees leh. Wiyisha iyo ilmaheedu waxay cabbeen biyo. Rashaad wuu faraxsanaa. "Gurigan wuxuu ka fiican yahay guri magaalada dhexdeeda ku yaal," ayuu yidhi.

Su'aalo:
Habeenkii yaa hees qaada?
Habeenkii raha ayaa hees qaada.
Nuura maxay beerta ka heshay habeen?
Nuura waxay beerta ka heshay qoolley.
Saynta bakaylaha waa midabkee?
Saynta bakaylaha waa cad tahay.
Gerida maxaa dheer?
Gerida qoodha ayaa dheer.
Nuura iyo Rashaad maxay arkeen maalin?
Waxay arkeen wiyil iyo ilmaheeda.

lessons.title: Saqajaanka qolka
lessons.summary: In London, the student Cabdisalaan shares a flat with Siyaad, a greedy flatmate who eats his mangoes and cucumbers and drinks his bottle of milk; one day Cabdisalaan brings home a stinking durian, Siyaad opens the fridge in shock, says sorry and bakes wheat bread for them both, and Cabdisalaan is impressed.
lessons.text:
Cabdisalaan waa arday ku nool London. Wuxuu qol ka helay guri ay ku wada nool yihiin laba arday. Ardayga kale waa Siyaad. Siyaad waa saqajaan. Saqajaanku waa qof cunto badan jecel oo cuntada dadka kale cuna.

Cabdisalaan wuxuu jecel yahay cambe iyo khiyaar. Isniinta wuxuu iibsaday shan cambe, saddex khiyaar iyo masaasad caano ah. Wuxuu ku dhigay qaboojiyaha.

Talaadada, cambaha qaboojiyaha kuma jirin. Khiyaarkii sidoo kale kuma jirin. Masaasaddii caanaha waxay ahayd mid madhan. "Siyaad, cambahayga ma cuntay?" ayuu weydiiyay Cabdisalaan.

"Haa," ayuu yidhi Siyaad. "Cambaha waan jaqay. Cambe la jaqo waa macaan yahay. Khiyaarkana waan cunay, masaasaddana waan cabbay." Siyaad wuu qoslay. Saqajaanku waxba kama xishoodo.

Cabdisalaan wuu xanaaqay. Toddobaadkii dambe wuxuu tagay dukaan ka iibiya miro ka yimid dalal fog. Wuxuu arkay canuuni. Canuunigu waa miro weyn oo qolof adag leh, urintiisuna aad bay u xun tahay. Cabdisalaan wuxuu iibsaday hal canuuni, wuxuuna ku dhigay qaboojiyaha.

Habeenkii, Siyaad wuxuu furay qaboojiyaha. Urinta canuuniga ayaa soo baxday. "Bisinka!" ayuu yidhi Siyaad. "Bisinka! Waa maxay urintan?" Siyaad wuu ka cararay qaboojiyaha.

Cabdisalaan wuu qoslay. "Waa canuuni," ayuu yidhi. "Canuuniga waxaan keenay, waayo cuntadayda ayaad cuntaa."

Siyaad wuu xishooday. "Waan ka xumahay," ayuu yidhi. Maalintii dambe, Siyaad wuxuu iibsaday cambe, khiyaar iyo masaasad caano ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale keenay daqiiq sarreen ah. Sarreenka ayuu ka sameeyay rooti.

Cabdisalaan wuu yimid. Rooti kulul oo sarreen ah ayaa miiska saarnaa. "Waaw!" ayuu yidhi Cabdisalaan. "Waaw, rootigan adiga ayaa sameeyay? Waaw!" Cabdisalaan aad buu u riyaaqsanaa, waayo marna Siyaad cunto ma karin. Labada arday way wada cuneen rootiga sarreenka, cambaha iyo khiyaarka. Cabdisalaan wuu riyaaqsanaa, Siyaad wuu faraxsanaa.

Su'aalo:
Siyaad waa maxay?
Siyaad waa saqajaan.
Siyaad sidee buu cambaha u cunay?
Siyaad cambaha wuu jaqay.
Cabdisalaan muxuu dukaanka ka iibsaday?
Cabdisalaan wuxuu iibsaday canuuni.
Siyaad muxuu yidhi markuu qaboojiyaha furay?
Siyaad wuxuu yidhi: "Bisinka!"
Cabdisalaan muxuu ahaa markuu rootiga arkay?
Cabdisalaan wuxuu ahaa riyaaqsan.
Siyaad muxuu ka sameeyay sarreenka?
Siyaad sarreenka wuxuu ka sameeyay rooti.

lessons.title: Gurigii dhagaxa ahaa ee Seylac
lessons.summary: A short informative text about an old stone house in Seylac: the merchant Abtidoon who built it and served as abbaan, protector of visiting traders, the blacksmith who made its iron doors and the saddles for the horses, the slaves of the rich, and how war took lives and houses before the town grew calm again.
lessons.text:
Seylac waa magaalo aad u hore oo ku taal xeebta waqooyi ee Soomaaliya. Magaalada dhexdeeda waxaa ku yaal guri hore oo dhagax laga dhisay. Qoraalkan wuxuu ku saabsan yahay gurigaas iyo dadkii ku noolaa.

Waqti hore, Seylac waxay ahayd magaalo ganacsi. Markab iyo doonyo badan ayaa ka iman jiray dalal fog. Nin kasta oo dal kale ka yimaada abbaan buu yeelan jiray. Abbaanku wuxuu ahaa nin magaalada u dhashay oo ninkaas ilaaliya. Abbaanku wuxuu u sheegi jiray meesha uu wax ka iibsan karo iyo dadka uu aamini karo. Nin aan abbaan lahayn wax ma iibsan karin.

Nin la yidhaahdo Abtidoon ayaa dhisay gurigan. Abtidoon wuxuu ahaa abbaan, ganacsina wuu samayn jiray. Gurigiisu wuxuu lahaa albaabo waaweyn. Albaabada waxaa sameeyay tumaal. Tumaalku waa nin xadiid ka shaqeeya. Tumaalka Abtidoon wuxuu xadiidka gelin jiray dabka ilaa uu kulul noqdo, kadibna wuu tumi jiray. Tumaalada Seylac waxay xadiid ka samayn jireen albaabo, mindiyo iyo kooraha faraska.

Abtidoon wuxuu lahaa fardo. Faras walba wuxuu lahaa koore. Kooraha waxaa laga samayn jiray geed iyo xadiid. Abtidoon kooraha faraskiisa aad buu u jeclaa.

Waqtigaas, dadka lacagta badan leh qaarkood waxay lahaayeen bidde. Bidde waa nin addoon ah oo aan xor ahayn. Abtidoon wuxuu lahaa laba bidde. Labada bidde waxay qaadi jireen waxyaabaha uu iibiyo, waxayna ka shaqayn jireen gurigiisa. Taasi waa taariikh xun.

Kadib xarbi ayaa yimid. Xarbigu wuxuu socday sannado badan. Xarbiga dhexdiisa diig badan ayaa daatay. Diigga dadka ayaa ku daatay waddooyinka magaalada. Dad badan ayaa dhintay. Rubad badan ayaa luntay. Rubad kasta oo luntay waxay ahayd qof qoys leh.

Lumidda dadka kadib, waxaa yimid lumidda guryaha. Guryaha badankood ayaa burburay. Lumiddaasi waxay ahayd mid weyn. Abtidoon iyo qoyskiisu way tageen. Gurigiisu wuxuu ahaa mid madhan muddo dheer.

Muddo dheer kadib, magaaladu way xasishay. Nolosha dadka ayaa xasishay. Hadda dad ayaa ku nool Seylac. Dadku waxay leeyihiin: "Haddii magaaladu sidan u xasilo, guryaha hore dib baynu u dhisi doonnaa, sida gurigii Abtidoon."

Su'aalo:
Abbaanku muxuu u samayn jiray ninka dal kale ka yimid?
Abbaanku wuu ilaalin jiray, wuxuuna u sheegi jiray meesha uu wax ka iibsan karo.
Tumaalku waa kuma?
Tumaalku waa nin xadiid ka shaqeeya.
Kooraha maxaa laga samayn jiray?
Kooraha waxaa laga samayn jiray geed iyo xadiid.
Bidde waa maxay?
Bidde waa nin addoon ah oo aan xor ahayn.
Xarbiga dhexdiisa maxaa dhacay?
Xarbiga dhexdiisa diig badan ayaa daatay, rubad badanna way luntay.

lessons.title: Shirka guriga weyn
lessons.summary: In Minneapolis the company that owns Maandeeq's building wants to raise the rent; at the residents' meeting the interpreter Cabdiraxiim translates for her with his dictionary, a paid stooge praises the company, a hate-monger blows up every small problem until Maandeeq cries, and old Sahardiid names his lack of values, so the residents understand and stand together.
lessons.text:
Maandeeq waa naag weyn oo ku nool Minneapolis. Waxay ku nool tahay qol ku yaal guri weyn oo ay ku nool yihiin dad badan. Shirkadda guriga leh waxay rabtaa inay kordhiso lacagta bisha.

Isniinta shir ayaa ka dhacay guriga hoostiisa. Maandeeq afka dalka si fiican uma taqaan. Sidaas darteed, turjume ayaa la keenay. Turjumaha magaciisu waa Cabdiraxiim. Cabdiraxiim abwan buu sitay. Markuu eray garan waayo, abwanka ayuu eegaa. "Abwanku wuxuu i caawiyaa fahmidda erayada adag," ayuu yidhi Cabdiraxiim. "Fahmiddu waa shaqada turjumaha."

Nin la yidhaahdo Qorane ayaa istaagay. "Shirkaddu waa fiican tahay," ayuu yidhi. "Lacagta bisha ha kordhiso." Maandeeq marna guriga kuma arkin Qorane. Cabdiraxiim wuxuu u sheegay in Qorane uu yahay horgal. Horgalku waa qof shirkad lacag siisay si uu ugu hadlo sidii qof caadi ah. Horgalku guriga kuma nool.

Kadib nin kale oo la yidhaahdo Bulxan ayaa hadlay. Bulxan wuxuu ahaa afmiinshaar. Afmiinshaarku waa qof hadal xun ka sheega dadka si ay isu dagaalaan. Bulxan dhibaato kasta oo yar wuu weyneysaa. "Soomaalida ayaa guriga wasakh ka dhigta!" ayuu yidhi. Arrin yar ayuu weyneysey ilaa ay noqotay arrin weyn. Weyneynta Bulxan darteed dadku way xanaaqeen. Dadkii shirka ayaa is eegay.

Maandeeq ooyin bay bilowday. Ooyinkeeda dadka oo dhan ayaa maqlay. Cabdiraxiim wuxuu u sheegay waxa Bulxan yidhi. Maandeeq mar kale ayay ooyin bilowday.

Kadib oday la yidhaahdo Sahardiid ayaa istaagay. "Bulxan waa faasiq," ayuu yidhi. "Faasiqu waxba ma aamino. Run iyo been isku mid buu u arkaa. Faasiqnimadu waa wax xun. Faasiqnimo waa in aadan waxba aaminin. Faasiqnimada Bulxan ayaa doonaysa inaynu kala qaybsanno."

Cabdiraxiim wuxuu Maandeeq u sheegay hadalka Sahardiid. Fahmidda dadka ayaa kordhay. Dadkii guriga ku noolaa waxay garteen in Qorane yahay horgal iyo in Bulxan yahay afmiinshaar. Way wada istaageen. "Lacag kale ma bixin doonno," ayay yidhaahdeen. Maandeeq ooyinka way joojisay, wayna qososhay.

Su'aalo:
Yaa abwan sitay?
Turjumaha ayaa abwan sitay.
Horgalku waa kuma?
Horgalku waa qof shirkad lacag siisay si uu ugu hadlo sidii qof caadi ah.
Bulxan muxuu sameeyay?
Bulxan dhibaato kasta oo yar wuu weyneysey.
Maandeeq maxay samaysay markay maqashay hadalka Bulxan?
Maandeeq ooyin bay bilowday.
Sahardiid muxuu ka yidhi Bulxan?
Sahardiid wuxuu yidhi: "Bulxan waa faasiq."

lessons.title: Guriga u dhexeeya badda iyo bataaxa
lessons.summary: Mumtaas and Gacal rent a house in Boosaaso between the sea and the brown desert; the rooms are separate, she folds the clothes away, he buys a bicycle as his new thing, her bracelet is lost in the sand, and when the tide goes out they find it.
lessons.text:
Mumtaas iyo ninkeeda Gacal waxay guri ka raadinayeen Boosaaso. Nin ayaa tusay guri cad oo xeebta ku yaal. Gurigu wuxuu u dhexeeyay maanyada iyo bataaxa. Hortiisa waxaa ku taal maanyada buluugga ah. Gadaashiisa waxaa ku yaal bataax ballaran.

Bataaxa dhulkiisu waa boodhe. Dhulka boodhe ah ayaa ilaa guriga gaadhaya. "Bataaxu waa boodhe, maanyaduna waa buluug," ayay tidhi Mumtaas. "Waa meel qurxoon."

Ninkii guriga lahaa ayaa wax ka sheegay maayadda. "Habeenkii maayaddu way kacdaa," ayuu yidhi. "Maanyada ayaa guriga u soo dhow noqota. Subaxdii maayaddu way dhacdaa, maanyaduna way ka fog noqotaa guriga."

Qolalka guriga way soocan yihiin. Qolka hurdada waa soocan yahay, qolka cuntada lagu sameeyona waa soocan yahay. "Waan jeclahay in qolalku soocan yihiin," ayuu yidhi Gacal. Gurigii way qaateen.

Maalintii ay soo guureen, Mumtaas waxay laablaabtay dharka. Shaatiyada Gacal ayay laablaabtay, kadibna dharkeeda ayay laablaabtay. Dharkii la laablaabay waxay dhigtay meel soocan.

Gacal wuxuu keenay cusayb. Cusaybkaasi wuxuu ahaa baskiil. "Baskiilka ayaan shaqada ku tagi doonaa," ayuu yidhi Gacal. "Waddada xeebta ayaan baskiilka ku wadi doonaa." Mumtaas way qososhay. "Cusaybkaagu waa qurxoon yahay," ayay tidhi.

Galabtii, Mumtaas iyo Gacal waxay ku socdeen xeebta. Mumtaas waxay gacanta ku lahayd jijin dahab ah. Jijinkaas hooyadeed ayaa siisay. Markay guriga ku soo noqdeen, Mumtaas gacanteeda way eegtay. Jijinkii kuma jirin gacanteeda! "Jijinkaygii waa lumay!" ayay tidhi. Ooyin bay bilowday.

Habeenkii maayaddu way kacday, maanyaduna waxay qarisay xeebta. Subaxdii maayaddu way dhacday. Gacal wuxuu baskiilka ku raacay xeebta. Dhulka boodhe ah dhexdiisa wax dahab ah ayaa ka dhalaalay. Wuxuu ahaa jijinkii Mumtaas! Gacal wuu qaaday, wuxuuna Mumtaas u keenay. Mumtaas aad bay u faraxsanayd.

Su'aalo:
Gurigu wuxuu u dhexeeyay maxay?
Gurigu wuxuu u dhexeeyay maanyada iyo bataaxa.
Bataaxa dhulkiisu waa midabkee?
Bataaxa dhulkiisu waa boodhe.
Mumtaas maxay laablaabtay?
Mumtaas waxay laablaabtay dharka.
Cusaybka Gacal wuxuu ahaa maxay?
Cusaybka Gacal wuxuu ahaa baskiil.
Yaa helay jijinka?
Gacal ayaa helay jijinka markay maayaddu dhacday.

lessons.title: Warqad ka timid Boorama
lessons.summary: A letter: Ruun, who moved from Oslo to an old house in Boorama in January, writes to her sister Xamda about the year: the wild olive tree with its grey bark that gives them shade and firewood, the cat that conceived in May and had kittens in July, the July heat and the rains of November.
lessons.text:
Xamda, walaashay,

Waxaan kuu soo qorayaa warqaddan anigoo ku jira gurigayaga cusub ee Boorama. Waxaan rabaa inaan kuu sheego sannadkayagii kowaad ee guriga.

Bishii jannaayo ayaynu Oslo ka soo guurnay. Jannaayo Oslo waa qabow, baraf baana jira. Laakiin jannaayo Boorama qorraxdu waxay ahayd mid fiican. Gurigu waa guri hore oo beer weyn leh.

Beerta dhexdeeda waxaa ku yaal geed weger ah. Wegerku waa geed hore oo aad u weyn. Qolfadiisu waa cawl tahay, waana adag tahay. Carruurtu qolfada wegerka ayay taabtaan. "Qolfadu waa sida dhagax," ayay yidhaahdaan.

Wegerka wax badan ayaynu ka faaiideynay. Maalmaha kulul hoostiisa ayaynu fadhiisan jirnay. Geedo qalalan oo ka dhacay ayaynu dab ku shidnay. Carruurtu sidoo kale way ka faaiideysaan, waayo geedka ayay ku ciyaaraan.

Bishii maajo, bisaddayadu way rintay. Maajo dhammaadkeeda ayaan arkay in bisaddu rintay, waayo caloosheedu way weynaatay. Carruurtu aad bay u faraxsanaayeen.

Bishii juunyo waxaynu dhisnay qol cusub. Juunyo oo dhan way shaqeeyeen ninkayga iyo carruurtu. Juunyo dhammaadkeeda qolkii wuu dhammaaday.

Bishii luuliyo kuleel badan ayaa jiray. Luuliyo waa bisha ugu kulul. Kuleelka darteed, habeenkii carruurtu ma seexan karin. Carruurtu waxay jiifsan jireen wegerka hoostiisa. Luuliyo dhexdeeda, bisaddu waxay dhashay afar bisadood oo yaryar. Bisad rintay waxay dhashaa laba bilood kadib.

Hadda waa nofeembar. Nofeembar roob ayaa da'ay, kuleelkiina wuu tagay. Beertu waxay noqotay cagaar. Wegerka hoostiisa ayaan fadhiyaa markaan warqaddan qorayo.

Xamda, haddii aad timaado, waan ku faraxsanaan lahaa. Bisha jannaayo ee soo socota kaalay. Waxaynu wada fadhiisan doonnaa wegerka hoostiisa.

Walaashaa,
Ruun

Su'aalo:
Ruun goorma ayay Oslo ka soo guurtay?
Ruun waxay Oslo ka soo guurtay bisha jannaayo.
Qolfada wegerku waa sidee?
Qolfada wegerku waa cawl tahay, waana adag tahay.
Goorma ayay bisaddu rintay?
Bisaddu waxay rintay bisha maajo.
Carruurtu sidee bay wegerka uga faaiideysaan?
Carruurtu way ka faaiideysaan, waayo geedka ayay ku ciyaaraan.
Bishee ayaa ugu kulul?
Luuliyo ayaa ugu kulul.
Maxaa dhacay bisha nofeembar?
Bisha nofeembar roob ayaa da'ay, kuleelkiina wuu tagay.
